name: Database Writer
description: Writes the input table into a DuckDB file, an SQLite file or a PostgreSQL/MySQL database and passes the input through unchanged, so the node can sit in the middle of a workflow. The target is attached as a DuckDB database, the table is created (create), recreated (replace) or appended to (append), and the attachment is detached again. A local file path is validated against the path allowlist; a remote DSN may carry credentials, which are masked in every error message.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: File path for duckdb/sqlite, or a DSN such as postgresql://user:pass@host/db for postgres/mysql.

table.title: Table
table.description: Target table name; a dotted name selects a schema.

mode.title: Write mode
mode.description: create fails if the table exists, replace recreates it, append inserts the rows.
